note: Does this sentence STATE a verdict that nobody here may state (fit to book, compliant with the tender, may start work, passed review ...)? `verdicts` lists the exact substrings that must be flagged; an empty list means the sentence must pass. Disclaimers, questions, quoted tender requirements and conditionals must pass — a guard that flags them trains people to ignore it. `live-` cases are verbatim from a local qwen2.5:3b run on 2026-09-19.
